title: PICKLEBALL BEGINNER PROTOCOL
tagline: MOVE BETTER. PLAY LONGER. LOWER INJURY RISK.
goal: Learn the movement patterns. Build mobility, stability and control. Play with less pain and more confidence.

overview.focus: Learn the basics and build control.

overview.title: Confidence & Play
overview.focus: Put it all together for consistent, pain-free play.

Week 4 Workout C subtitle prints 'light agllity' (typo for 'agility'); kept as printed.
Week 1 Workout C #6 last cue 'Short, controlled movements.' sits on the table's bottom edge and is partly clipped; read as shown.
Week 4 Workout C #3 'LATERAL SHUFFLE (5-10 YD)' is dosed '4 × 20 ft each direction' (name in yards, dosage in feet); kept as printed.
Week 2 Workout A #3 Glute Bridge '3 × 15 (3 s hold)': reps kept as '15 (3 s hold)' and also put '3 s hold' in dosage.hold.
Inch marks on box heights ('6-8" BOX', '8-12" BOX', '12-16" BOX') printed as typographic quotes; written as ASCII double quote.
Week headers say '30-45 MINUTES EACH' while every workout time box says 30-40; both kept as printed.
Post-workout recovery items are not numbered on the sheet; n is assigned 1-4 in sheet order.
sourceNotes: Read 6 sheets (weeks 1-6), each 1536x1024, downloaded from Google Drive thumbnails at w2400 and cropped/upscaled 2x per workout table. No missing or duplicate sheets. Week 1 sheet is titled 'PICKLEBALL PERFORMANCE PROTOCOL' (band: 'BEGINNER PICKLEBALL PROTOCOL | WEEK 1'); weeks 2-6 are titled 'PICKLEBALL BEGINNER PROTOCOL'. Week 1 overview strip 'Pickleball Performance Protocol': BEGINNER (Weeks 1-6): Learn the movement patterns. Build mobility, stability and control. Play with less pain and more confidence. | INTERMEDIATE (Weeks 1-6): Increase strength, speed and endurance. Add directional power and court-specific movements. Improve consistency and reaction control. | ADVANCED (Weeks 1-6): Maximize power, speed and agility. Develop high-level movement patterns. Perform, compete and stay resilient long term. Top-left box on every sheet: 'BEGINNER 6-WEEK PROGRAM' with bullets Build a strong foundation / Improve mobility and stability / Learn proper movement patterns / Reduce injury risk / Play with more confidence (recorded in progression.expect). The 6-week progression strip (progression.overview) appears on weeks 2-6 only. KEY CUES (EVERY WORKOUT) recorded as principles. PRE-WORKOUT WARM-UP (5-8 MIN) and POST-WORKOUT RECOVERY (5-10 MIN) are identical on all six sheets and are included as exercise groups in every week. Each workout is a table with columns # / EXERCISE / SETS × REPS / CUES (week 1 has no column headings); no how-to, captions or pro tips on these sheets.
